name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
label: Quest
description: The Fare of Lar'korwi: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind.
Lar'korwi killed him not far from this spot.
If you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not take my words lightly, friend. If you truly wish to face this creature, then you must be careful... And smart. It will take a great deal of strength and insight to draw out Lar'korwi and defeat him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This will do nicely, friend. It seems Lar'korwi eats well these days. Although, I wonder where he found a threshadon in this area. Odd.

Regardless, I will hold onto this until you are ready for your confrontation with the beast. Do not worry for my safety--I am sure you've angered Lar'korwi enough that he will not kill me until after he's tasted your flesh.
